name: JW Marriott Hotel Seoul
insider_take: Seoul's crown jewel rises 30 floors above Gangnam, where cutting-edge luxury meets timeless Korean hospitality in the heart of Asia's tech capital.
whats_special: This architectural marvel sits in the prestigious Gangnam District, just steps from COEX Mall - Asia's largest underground shopping complex. The hotel's signature spa features traditional Korean jjimjilbang treatments alongside modern wellness therapies, while the rooftop offers stunning views of the Han River and N Seoul Tower.
pro_tip: Book dinner at the hotel's Mikuni Seoul on the 30th floor - it's the only Mikuni restaurant outside Japan and offers panoramic city views alongside exceptional Japanese-French fusion cuisine.
dont_miss: The nearby Bongeunsa Temple provides a serene 1,200-year-old Buddhist sanctuary amid the urban buzz, while Gangnam's legendary nightlife scene and K-pop entertainment district are literally at your doorstep. The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of Samsung's headquarters and the trendy Apgujeong shopping district.
pros: Prime location in Gangnam district with excellent shopping and business access
Luxurious accommodations with modern amenities and city views
Multiple high-quality dining options including Michelin-starred restaurants
Comprehensive spa and wellness facilities with traditional Korean treatments
cons: Busy urban location may not suit those seeking tranquil retreat
